_comment: Five Nights at Freddy's (1-6) collection: animatronic forms. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. Requested by name: Teddiursa line as Classic Freddy, Torchic line as Classic Chica, Sandile line as Classic Foxy. The other 15 were picked with `generate.py pick --count 15 --seed fnaf-1987` and dealt round-robin one look per game: FNAF1 classic, FNAF2 withered + toy, FNAF3 springtrap, FNAF4 nightmare, FNAF5 funtime, FNAF6 scrap.

readme.title: Five Nights at Freddy's (Animatronics)
readme.summary: Pokemon rebuilt as pizzeria animatronics, with eyes that glow in the dark.
looks: each other line wears the look of one game: Classic (FNAF 1), Withered and Toy (FNAF 2), Springtrap (FNAF 3), Nightmare (FNAF 4), Funtime (FNAF 5) or Scrap (FNAF 6)
felt, seams, rivets, grime, endoskeleton tears, wires and animatronic teeth

specials.look: Classic Freddy: brown felt bear, top hat, bow tie, glowing blue eyes
Classic Chica: yellow felt chicken with the LET'S EAT!!! bib and glowing violet eyes
Classic Foxy: rust-red fox suit torn to the endoskeleton, eye patch, one glowing amber eye
